READ THE NUMBERS CORRECTLY

A model you can inspect.

The number of stations selects a demo tier. It does not multiply the same investment amount once per station.

Is the amount split between selected stations?+

Yes. The demo allocates the selected amount across your reference stations. The weekly percentage applies to the total invested amount once. Selecting 5 stations does not turn $250 into a $1,250 investment.

Does the percentage come from actual station revenue?+

No. The public directory is not connected to revenue records. The weekly percentages are proposed demo terms; they do not demonstrate that station earnings support those rates.

What about fees, withdrawals and losses?+

Final fees, eligibility, withdrawal rules, ownership rights and risk disclosures have not been provided. Review these in verified offering documents before considering any real investment.
